notes.title: PAX East Showcase 2025 + Live Demo
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We’re excited to share that Tales of Old: Dominus will be showcased at PAX East! Also, don’t forget to try out the game’s demo, which is live now and gives you a glimpse of the gameplay experience.

While the game has evolved significantly since the demo, it still offers a solid idea of what to expect. Most importantly, we’d love to hear your thoughts—any feedback is greatly appreciated as we continue to improve the game.

PAX East 2025 will take place from May 8–11 at the Boston Convention & Exhibition Center.

notes.title: Thank You for Your Support – Try the Dominus Demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We sincerely appreciate all your interest, the growing number of followers and wishlists, and your incredible support—we're truly happy with the results so far!

Please keep sharing your thoughts and feedback with us so we can continue improving everything as much as possible for the final version of Dominus.

And don’t forget to try the demo during this Steam Next Fest week!
It’s a pleasure to have you all on board!

Matt

notes.title: Try the Demo - Join Us at Steam Next Fest – February 2025!
notes.notes:
Hey there, dear friends! How are you all doing?

We’re excited to announce that we’ll be participating in the Steam Next Fest this February 2025!

We’d love for you to try out the demo and share your thoughts with us. Of course, it’s still a work in progress, but we believe it will give you a good idea of what the game will be like once it's fully optimized and polished!

We truly appreciate your support and for sticking with us all this time!

Matt

notes.title: Publisher Collaboration Announcement !
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We’re thrilled to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761000/Tales_of_Old_Dominus/]Tales of Old: Dominus[/url] will officially be published by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io[/url]! As many of you know, a publisher takes care of key aspects like managing store pages, launching marketing campaigns, organizing live and digital events, handling PR, and so much more.

This collaboration allows us to fully dedicate ourselves to creating the best game possible, with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io’s[/url] help and expertise guiding us along the way.

We couldn’t have reached this point without your amazing support. If you haven’t already, please wishlist follow us, and be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cuknFYkTHP]Discord [/url]!

Thanks a lot,
Matt

notes.title: Hillstowe Abbey - A new game area
notes.notes:
Hello guys, here we show you a new little village to visit.

We have improved the landscape and the reaction to climate change.

Also, the sound changes when entering a place with a roof or a closed area like a house. This is quite noticeable when there are strong storms or winds and the player must find shelter.

We are also improving the effects that wet the character and also different elements of the world such as walls and other objects.

[previewyoutube=Flfm5FLRONE;full][/previewyoutube]

Feedback is welcome !
